Senses.Explanation: Chan records use this term for the nature said in a quoted scripture formula to belong to sentient beings, but they do not leave that claim as a settled possession. Yanguan Qi'an states that all sentient beings have Buddha-nature, while Guishan Lingyou states the direct inversion that none have it (一切眾生皆無佛性。一切眾生皆有佛性). When social rank is used against Huineng, he answers that people may be north or south but Buddha-nature has no north or south (人則有南北，佛性無南北). The term becomes a public test in the earthworm case: Secretary Zhu asks where Buddha-nature is when a cut earthworm's two ends both move, and Changsha Jingcen answers, 'Do not fantasize' (蚯蚓斬為兩段，兩頭俱動，未審佛性在阿那頭？師云：莫妄想). Zhaozhou's record intensifies the instability. Asked whether a dog has Buddha-nature, he answers 'no'; when challenged that everything down to ants has it, he says the dog has action-consciousness nature (狗子還有佛性也無？師云：無……為伊有業識性在). Elsewhere he answers 'yes' when asked about a cypress tree (柏樹子還有佛性也無？師云：有), and he groups Buddha-nature with awakening, extinction, and true thusness as skin-clinging clothes also called vexations (菩提、涅槃、真如、佛性，盡是貼體衣服，亦名煩惱). Dahui Zonggao later tells an addressee to look at the saying consisting of Zhaozhou's dog question and answer 'no' and to keep raising it at all times (看箇話頭。僧問趙州。狗子還有佛性也無。州云無。行住坐臥但時時提掇). The entry therefore records one corpus-wide headword under conflicting assertions, questions, answers, and case reuse; it does not rule on what possesses Buddha-nature.
Senses.Note: The headword has 4,137 hits in 363 allowlisted texts. The all-beings affirmative occurs 64 times in 46 texts; direct what-is questions occur 43 times in 32; the earthworm test appears in at least 13 texts; and the dog-question family occurs in more than 100 texts. These counts establish breadth, not agreement. The former general-claim-versus-Zhaozhou split was rejected under item 8: the referent remains Buddha-nature while speakers affirm, deny, question, destabilize, or reuse it. Different stances and answers are not different things. Every Chinese quotation retained in the explanation is anchored in the stored occurrences.
